name: attio-ci-integration
description: Build a bounded CI contract gate for an Attio integration using fixtures, schema checks, and an optional read-only smoke request. Use when Attio changes need pull-request evidence without mutating CRM data. Trigger with "Attio CI", "test Attio integration", or "Attio pull request gate".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect workflows, fixtures, client code, and secret names. Use `WebFetch` only for current official Attio documentation. Use
